name: admin_command_policy_mapping
description: Manages a DuploCloud AI Helpdesk command policy mapping — binds a command policy to a scope (System, Workspace, or Project), putting the policy's allow/block command rules into effect for tickets in that scope. Only one active mapping may exist per System scope, and per Workspace/Project target.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the command policy mapping.

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: ID of the command policy this mapping applies. Must reference an existing, active command policy.

attributes.name: level
attributes.description: Scope level the policy is bound to: System (platform-wide), Workspace, or Project.

attributes.name: target_ids
attributes.description: IDs of the targets this mapping applies to: workspace IDs when level is Workspace, project IDs when level is Project. Required for Workspace and Project levels; must be omitted for System level.

attributes.name: metadata
attributes.description: Arbitrary key/value metadata attached to the mapping.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Whether the mapping is active. Defaults to true. Only active mappings take effect and are checked for scope conflicts.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who created the mapping.

attributes.name: updated_by
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who last updated the mapping.

attributes.name: created_at
attributes.description: Timestamp when the mapping was created (RFC 3339).

attributes.name: updated_at
attributes.description: Timestamp when the mapping was last updated (RFC 3339).
